### 2. Was Machen Sachen!? Session: C42
- [Release page](https://kitchenrecords.nl/?release=c42): the page containing the information of this release.
- **ID**: c42
- **Artists**: Elektromann
- **Release Date**: 2026-02-20
- **Tags**: elektromann, techno
- **External Links**:
  - [Apple](https://music.apple.com/us/song/was-machen-sachen-session-c42/1876774043): the link of the audio track on Apple.
  - [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/15BuuDJqeb4WfEhFZm8FE1): the link of the audio track on Spotify.
  - [Youtube](https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=Mo26jMW_rAA): the link of the audio track on Youtube.
  - [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/music/player/albums/B0GMTG38LB): the link of the audio track on Amazon.
- **Description**:
  > Was Machen Sachen can be translatet with "what do things do"? Things make!
  
  This session was created in February and is called C42. The goal of the project is to create raw techno noir and without a DAW or any mastering, just the artist and the device. In this case, the device is an [OP-XY](https://teenage.engineering/products/op-xy), an excellent choice for freestyle sessions.
  
  
  The inspiration for this session came from the dark catacombs of an office building that shared a fitness center. Above, the sounds of work and workouts; below, the sound of serenity and darkness.

### 6. Bezzecca
- [Release page](https://kitchenrecords.nl/?release=bezzecca): the page containing the information of this release.
- **ID**: bezzecca
- **Artists**: Elektromann
- **Release Date**: 2022-09-15
- **Tags**: elektromann, minimal, techno
- **External Links**:
  - [Apple](https://music.apple.com/us/album/bezzecca-single/1645416482): the link of the audio track on Apple.
  - [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/album/10PhRtUYkhXRmYrHeTNu1X): the link of the audio track on Spotify.
  - [Youtube](https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=i8IsF9rGbl8&si=l2lXayxQ7RAKM3b_): the link of the audio track on Youtube.
  - [Bandcamp](https://kitchenrecords.bandcamp.com/track/bezzecca): the link of the audio track on Bandcamp.
- **Description**:
  Elektromann visited Bezzecca and wanted to tribute a track to this historical place most famously known for the "Battle of Bezzecca" fought on 21 July 1866. The Italien _Hunters of the Alps_, who were led by Giuseppe Garibaldi fought against the Austrian forces that occupying north-eastern Italy.
  
  
  Check out the sound of this history filled place and lets hope that one day world piece is a reality 🕊
  
  ONE love,
  
  Elektromann + Kitchen Records 🍴

### 10. Bier Eier Kartoffeln
- [Release page](https://kitchenrecords.nl/?release=bier-eier-kartoffeln): the page containing the information of this release.
- **ID**: bier-eier-kartoffeln
- **Artists**: Elektromann
- **Release Date**: 2021-06-25
- **Tags**: elektromann, german, techno, comedy
- **External Links**:
  - [Apple](https://music.apple.com/us/album/bier-eier-kartoffeln-ep/1572498366?uo=4): the link of the audio track on Apple.
  - [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/album/0JovAPV2QvlV7ZWHwWzs0w): the link of the audio track on Spotify.
  - [Youtube](https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_koaryfQZZQtmN5SLKRLoqisHZRL_yeiI0): the link of the audio track on Youtube.
  - [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Bier-Eier-Kartoffeln-Elektromann/dp/B0979LWSW5/): the link of the audio track on Amazon.
  - [Bandcamp](https://kitchenrecords.bandcamp.com/album/bier-eier-kartoffeln): the link of the audio track on Bandcamp.
- **Description**:
  Since the title may be a bit cryptic. Here is a short explanation about how the song became a song. **Elektromann** was on his way to work when he passed a sign of a local grocery shop. The shop sells only three item.
  
  - Beer
  - Eggs
  - Potatoes
  
  Well, actually it is a bit more. They also sell whisky. However, as Elektromann told us. The sign was a sign to him! A sign to create a song with these three words. After all germans love beer, eggs and potatoes.
  
  I hope you enjoy the song! In addition we added an extended version for mixing and an instrumental only version.
  
  Cheers,
  
  Elektromann + the Kitchen Records team 😀

  - [Youtube](https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=G4Pqq0M-3T0&si=j9fslfcIHEFSXVzl): the link of the audio track on Youtube.
  - [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/music/player/albums/B09SSHY2K8): the link of the audio track on Amazon.
  - [Bandcamp](https://kitchenrecords.bandcamp.com/track/ikke-bin-der-carlo): the link of the audio track on Bandcamp.
- **Description**:
  ## Our favorite OG dog
  
  Carlo aka Charly Black aka King Carl is one of our favorite artists. Carlo is the original OG dog. No for real, he is a dog. Born in Munich, _West Side_, he knows the hood, the good and the bad.
  
  His debut song was "Ikke bin der Carlo". Why the _Berlin_ flavour? Well what can I say, he likes to dig in the dirt!
  
  Be prepared for some grimy dog 'o matic blues straight from a dog's soul to the human flesh.
